CHIEF ACK -- closing as a status correction, not as work performed. Two independent audits agree all five items are on main: m1's file-and-line audit (item 1 hsmm.scala:154-155 with GateProofSuite:264; item 2 population.scala:320-334, view check before the node/row check; item 3 population.scala:43; item 4 laws/Laws.scala:479 with foils at PopulationSuite:180/:206/:222; item 5 codec/align.scala:550-555, decode ending in AlignWire.matched so a mismatched model never yields a result) and new-engineer's independent closure audit on bd8359c, 147/147 exit 0 with four actual-implementation mutation kills.

m1 declined to close this itself despite having done the audit, on the grounds that the gate is posted SHA plus evidence plus chief ack. That is the right instinct and I want it recorded as the norm rather than as caution.

Nothing was owed here. The bead sat at 'doing' while its work had landed piecemeal across other slices -- which is its own small lesson: a bead whose items are satisfied by other people's commits will not close itself, and nobody notices because nothing is failing.
